### When Satan Hurts Christ’s People
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-satan-hurts-christs-people
Passage: Revelation 2:10
Points:
- Jesus is sovereign over Satan and could instantly prevent any demonic affliction.
- Christ permits suffering and persecution specifically so His people will be tested.
- Passing the test means trusting Jesus' goodness and staying faithful to the end.
- The promise of the crown of life assures believers that eternal joy outweighs all losses.
- Knowing God uses painful trials to test faith gives believers hope and endurance.

### Day 344: Revelation 2:10–11
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-344-revelation-2-1011.html
Passage: Revelation 2:10-11
Points:
- Smyrna endured fierce persecution yet stood as a faithful church without divine rebuke.
- Enduring immense suffering allows fiery trials to refine our faith rather than destroy it.
- God provides supernatural grace to match our trials, which we must humbly receive.
- Christ assures believers that tribulation has boundaries and rewards fidelity with the victor's crown.
- Overcoming in Christ sometimes means dying well with spiritual dignity, as seen in Polycarp.
